assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: high-detail panoramic background matte for a premium 3D platform game, Nightworks bonus quarry.
Primary request: create a single wide landscape image, approximately 3:1. A vast ancient floating slate quarry at midnight, giant broken natural stone arches and needle-like crags levitating above layers of soft smoky indigo cloud. Far-distant abandoned mining galleries and a few tiny amber fire lights tucked into cliffs. Broad open night sky occupies the upper half, dark blue storm wisps, small stars and a luminous veiled moon off centre. Majestic depth and crafted cinematic game environment art.
Style/medium: sumptuous highly detailed textured 3D environment matte painting; weathered chipped stratified blue-grey rock, believable material roughness, art-directed stylized proportions. Match a fantasy rocky Nightworks level with triangular torch flames, floating stone platforms, blue nocturnal atmosphere. Crisp enough to support a zoomed-out camera but distant forms and values remain quiet.
Composition: panoramic continuous scene with overlapping distant planes, side-on view into an immense quarry. Bottom third dissolves naturally into midnight indigo atmospheric fog. No close foreground platform, no characters, no UI, no text, no border, no watermarks, no grids. This is scenery behind interactive gameplay, not a screenshot or a game mockup.
Lighting: cool silver moon rim light on crag edges, desaturated blue shadows, tiny restrained warm amber accents. Visible rich detail, avoid crushed black or neon.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent panoramic mid-distance scenery cutout for Nightworks, a premium stylized 3D platform game.
Primary request: a long abandoned quarry dispatch depot built across five suspended slate rock islands. Tall timber pithead hoists, rusty winches, suspended chain hooks, stacked ore wagons, wooden gantries and a single ancient eroded natural stone arch. Small golden oil lanterns and dusty amber workshop windows punctuate cool midnight blue stone. Rich visible textures: chipped angular blue-grey rock strata, worn oak grain, corroded bronze metal, canvas awnings. Uneven hanging rock undersides, isolated ore shards. Beautifully lit sculpted 3D game environment matte art. Quiet eerie atmosphere, cinematic moonlight from upper left.
Composition: very wide 3:1 strip, viewed side-on with a very slight view down onto the tops, everything fully contained with safe margins around silhouette. Height variation with hoists rising at irregular intervals, generous gaps BETWEEN separate rock masses. Completely transparent sky, transparent gaps, transparent background, clean real alpha edges; no ground plane or cloudy rectangle. Detailed islands and industrial scenery occupy only the middle of this transparent canvas, leave transparency at top and bottom. Intended behind a side-scrolling gameplay lane; nothing in front.
Avoid people, characters, labels, text, UI, flat vector art, cartoon outlines, glowing neon, checkerboard painted into the image, cropped edges, collage borders.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless square 3D game material albedo texture, premium stylized Nightworks quarry stone.
Primary request: a top-down orthographic surface of weathered blue-grey slate bedrock, broad fractured layered stone plates, subtle iron mineral staining and dusty worn walking areas. Fine chipped edges, naturally varied rough mineral texture, restrained muted mineral gold flecks and cool slate blue. Hand-crafted high-budget stylized 3D game texture with realistic rich material detail, not photoreal gravel noise.
Composition: perfectly flat surface filling entire square, tileable horizontally and vertically, similar value on all edges; large readable stone forms with subordinate fine detail. Neutral diffuse illumination baked into color, no directional cast shadows, no specular highlights, no perspective, no separate objects, no grass, no moss, no glowing cracks, no borders or text. Mid-value blue-grey so it reads in moonlight with amber torch illumination.
